capabilities.name: Work-center/manufacturing integration
capabilities.verify: equipment.work_center_id + trigger work_order_needs_a_working_machine (a work order cannot start at a work center whose equipment is under_maintenance or broken, whoever the writer) + work_center_availability (skill) + the work-center field in the equipment form
capabilities.notes: Shipped 2026-09-20 — Odoo's idea, landed on the work orders from #563. maintenance_requests.blocks_equipment states whether a job takes the machine down (default: priority critical does, as before), and sync_equipment_status is the single writer of the status. Battery: plan-to-produce › no work starts on a machine that is down / closing the last blocking request brings the machine back.

capabilities.name: MTBF/MTTR statistics
capabilities.verify: maintenance_stats(p_equipment_id, p_months) + skill of the same name; admin: Maintenance → Reliability (failures, MTBF, MTTR, downtime, availability per machine)
capabilities.notes: Shipped 2026-09-20. MTTR runs from the request being raised until it was closed — the machine was unusable for all of it. MTBF is NULL with fewer than two failures and mtbf_note says why, instead of printing a mean from one failure. Battery: plan-to-produce › one failure is no mean between failures / but the time to restore is known.
